description: We are 6SuperNovas! We are an enthusiastic team of curious, innovative 6th-grade students with a deep passion for science, technology, and space exploration.
summary: Our character will go from planet to planet and do a various of challenges. For every challenge completed, the character will receive a badge and with enough badges the player can change the outfit and color of the character. The game only ends if the player has all badges an have completed all series of challenges.
details: Our character will try to complete a series of challenges and will earn coins and badges per challenge done. The goal of the game is to get all badges and complete all the challenges. We use Java Script based a platform to code our game. Our game topic is our character will travel all the planets and complete the information boxes.
